summary: Flow primitives: Stack stacks elements vertically, Inline lays them out horizontally (following the writing direction) with wrapping. Spacing always uses the token scale.
whenToUse: Spacing adjacent elements consistently without manual margins.
Action bars, tag groups, title + action rows.
whenNotToUse: To semantically group related buttons: use ButtonGroup.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Inline only: wraps when there is not enough space.

inherits: Global HTML attributes (id, aria-*, data-*, style, className) and native events; ref to the rendered element.
accessibility: Adds no roles: semantics depend on `as`. With as="ul", children must be <li>.
Visual order matches DOM order (no reordering via CSS).
responsive: Inline wraps by default: no horizontal overflow at 320 px.
Uses logical properties, so the order flips automatically in RTL.
customization: Selectors: .dc-stack-stack, .dc-stack-inline; spacing lives in the local --_gap variable.
commonMistakes: Adding margins to children to “fix” spacing: change the gap instead.
Using wrap={false} with long content on mobile.
